# SJ Physiotherapy

> SJ Physiotherapy is a physiotherapy and rehabilitation clinic in Singanallur, Coimbatore, India, offering evidence-based orthopaedic rehab, sports injury recovery, manual therapy, geriatric physiotherapy, and women's health physiotherapy (pregnancy, postpartum and pelvic floor care), with both in-clinic and home-visit services across Coimbatore.

SJ Physiotherapy was founded by Dr. Suriya (MPT, Sports Physiotherapy) and Dr. Jaycee (MPT, Orthopaedics), who provide personalized, assessment-driven treatment plans built around identifying the root cause of pain rather than treating symptoms alone. The clinic treats musculoskeletal conditions across the neck, back, shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee and foot; supports post-surgical rehabilitation, sports injuries, arthritis and balance/fall-prevention for older adults; and offers a dedicated women's health track covering pregnancy exercise, postpartum recovery, diastasis recti and pelvic floor training. Treatment techniques include manual therapy, myofascial release, dry needling, cupping therapy, IASTM, kinesio taping, electrotherapy, core stability training, biomechanical correction and ergonomic guidance.

## Services

- [Our Services | SJ Physiotherapy](https://sjphysiotherapy.in/): Full list of conditions treated (neck pain, low back pain, sciatica, spondylosis, frozen shoulder, shoulder impingement, rotator cuff injury, tennis/golfer's elbow, wrist pain, hip pain, knee pain, heel pain, plantar fasciitis, osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, post-surgical rehab, ligament/meniscus injury, ankle sprain, Achilles tendinitis, muscle strain), women's health services (pregnancy exercise, postpartum recovery, diastasis recti, urinary incontinence, pelvic floor training), geriatric care (balance disorders, vertigo rehab, fall prevention, walking training, strength training), and treatment techniques used (myofascial release, dry needling, cupping, IASTM, kinesio taping, electrotherapy, core stability, ergonomic correction), plus an FAQ section on sessions, referrals, home visits and what to expect.

## Company

- [About Us | SJ Physiotherapy](https://sjphysiotherapy.in/about-us/): Clinic story, mission, vision and core values (compassion, integrity, evidence-based practice); team profiles for founder Dr. Suriya, MPT (Sports Physiotherapy — dry needling, cupping, IASTM, kinesiotaping, biomechanical correction certified) and co-founder Dr. Jaycee, MPT (Orthopaedics, certified Women's Health Physiotherapy Practitioner). Also credits Raj Vishnu Kumar, a non-clinical team member (Web & Software Developer, Digital Marketer) who is not a physiotherapist or medical professional and does not provide patient treatment; he develops and maintains the clinic's website and patient record/billing software and manages its digital marketing and SEO.
